scope: Independent downstream biological common-input arithmetic only
source_observation_kind: Primary pages inspected with the web tool; no newly authenticated raw author-code or article body

source_pages.locator: Methods: Functional similarity among all postsynaptic neurons sharing one common input; Estimation of rho expected by pairwise like-to-like connectivity rules; Figure5 and Extended Data14
source_pages.supports: Weighted reduction algebra and distinction between observed graph and pairwise-model expectation; original within-volume biological interpretation.
Five weight families, Connected count eligibility, positive-weight selection, distinct-pair products, pre-post means and three within-group contrasts.

source_model_ambiguity.observation: The pinned setup_variables includes IN_VIVO_SIG_CORR alongside IN_SILICO_SIG_CORR_CVT, READOUT_SIMILARITY_CVT and READOUT_LOCATION_DISTANCE_CVT; main passes the list to fit_models. The common-input Methods names three functional features.
source_model_ambiguity.disposition: Unresolved original-model parity; no choice of fit recipe made here.

implementation_differences: Strict operator support/identity validation is a benchmark interface decision, not source-cohort authentication.
Only built-in int/float scalars are admitted; booleans, other numeric types and lossy integer coercion fail. No implicit library-scalar conversion is source-qualified.
Undefined positive-weight support is retained explicitly instead of relying on NumPy failure or disappearing groups.
Log normalization avoids overflow while preserving reduction algebra; no bitwise parity claim.
No signed-rank test, multiplicity adjustment, GLMM fit, reference tolerance or superiority decision is implemented.
